# Pulsus Cash

> Cash management software for banks and credit unions: tills, vaults, ATMs and cash orders in one live position, three-way reconciliation and days-of-cash forecasts.

This is the official website of Pulsus Cash: https://aboutcash.pulsus.tech/
Pulsus Cash is part of the Pulsus Intelligence Suite (https://about.pulsus.tech/), made by Tumblehill Labs, a product studio of Tumblehill Holdings LLC. It works on its own.

## What it is

Pulsus Cash is cash management software for tills, vaults and treasury. It brings every till, vault, ATM and cash order across your branches into one live position: what was counted, what the books say, where the two differ, and how many days of cash each location has left. Differences become exceptions that the branch explains and someone else closes, and Treasury plans replenishment from the same figures.

## Key features

- Pulse: Cash in hand, and how complete the day is
- Exceptions: Every break, owned and aged
- Performance: Trends against your treasury triggers
- Insights: Are we safe? What needs action? Where is our risk?
- Forecast: What Treasury has to move
- Reports: Operational, treasury and control

## Price

- $407 a month, which includes 12 tills and 1 vault in use; each extra till is $29 a month and each extra vault $59. A till marked as a branch vault counts as a vault, not a till. There is no charge per user or per ATM.
- Prices in US dollars, as shown on the plans page: https://aboutcash.pulsus.tech/plans/
- 14-day free trial, no card needed.
